channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: Wayne Gretzky comes to his own defence on U.S. criticism: 'I'm a hockey player, I'm a true Canadian'
item.description: Hockey legend Wayne Gretzky spoke with CBC prior to the Olympic men's hockey semifinal between Canada and Finland in Milan.

item.title: Man charged with first-degree murder in Rideau Street stabbing
item.description: Yves Brisebois, 70, has been charged in connection with stabbing death on Thursday evening.

item.title: Ski accident 'devastating for all involved,' Vorlage official says
item.description: A 13-year-old Ottawa girl died in hospital after her hoodie got snagged on a chairlift at the ski area in Wakefield on Feb. 11.

item.title: Canada-wide arrest warrant issued by Ottawa police in October 2025 homicide case
item.description: Zakarye Abdi-Jama, 19, is charged with second-degree murder in the stabbing death of Raphael Atende, 21.

item.title: Senators Olympic tracker: Brady Tkachuk, Jake Sanderson will dig for gold against Canada
item.description: Brady Tkachuk had a goal and an assist to help the U.S. beat Slovakia

item.title: Team Canada grades: MacKinnon throws knockout punch in dying seconds against Finland
item.description: Nathan MacKinnon capped off an incredible comeback in the semifinal.

item.title: Chris Cobb: In 1975, Ottawa suffered one of Canada's first school shootings. There was no playbook for how to respond
item.description: Staff and students returned to St. Pius the very next day, with the smell of disinfectant and paint still fresh.

item.title: More adults with developmental disabilities ending up in homeless shelters
item.description: "We were the only and last option," say officials with Inner City Health who help Ottawa’s shelter system.

item.title: Ottawa Police Service Polar Plunge gives $60K boost to Special Olympics
item.description: "Our goal was $50,000, and we raised more than that. On top of that, we're number one out of all the police services in the province."

item.title: Senators winger Drake Batherson says 'whole country is praying' Sidney Crosby suits up in gold-medal game
item.description: A summer training compatriot of Crosby, Batherson says the ailing Canadian Olympic team captain will do what's best for the squad in Sunday's showdown with the U.S.
